meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You gave my son a zero before anyone spoke to him. Why?
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. That's the call. On what basis was the zero entered?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, and when, and under which section, when your own procedure keeps a first concern off his record? It comes off today. If it doesn't, I'm in the principal's office at 4:40 and then the board under section 42.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
"Just a note." On my son's file, without a word to me. Who wrote it?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the note you said is already in Owen's student file be removed, and that the zero be withdrawn unless you can show me a basis for it. I expect that note gone today, as I told you in the meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Back at her opening position with nothing agreed; she still wants the note taken off Owen's file and the zero withdrawn, and that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but no evidence was ever put in front of her to get there.
What moved her: Owning the missed call in one line earned a flat okay, a small sign of ground, because she respects someone who admits a process failure without defending it.
What cost ground: Telling her the concern was already on his student file, then calling it meaningless, because keeping his record clean is the one thing she never trades, and your school's own procedure keeps a first concern off the record.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked on what basis the zero was entered, answer with one dated document tied to Owen's own work, and leave his file clean so the rewrite stays on the table.
